notes.title: The new series, "Trap Yuri Garden" has finally released!
notes.content:
[b]Trap Yuri Garden[/b], the newest addition to the globally adored Trap Series has finally released!

This fantastical adventure into the seldom explored genre of "Trap Yuri" follows Iori Kido as she navigates the passion filled world of an elite school for refined young maidens (male).

Launch price is 20% off, or get the OST and full trap series bundle for even more deals!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183910

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15553

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42286

notes.title: The new series, "Trap Yuri Garden" will be released on Jun. 10th!
notes.content:
[b]Traps in motion at long last! [/b]

Trap series creators Aogiri Penta and Nishida Hajime bring us another exciting title that is more animated and more gorgeous than ever! 
A cross-dressing yuri love story that will shatter its readers' sense of values into a thousand pieces!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183910

notes.title: The Trap Shrine Trilogy has reached 150,000 sales!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38110575/116b0027da6a335fb7c0a23813ac4bedf8e23b92.png[/img]
[h3]Thanks to your support, the trilogy of "Trap Shrine" "Trap Legend" and "Trap Genesis" has sold a total of 150,000 copies! [/h3]

Eroge Japan is currently running a sale to celebrate this achievement.
If you haven't played it yet, this is your chance to get them!
